sources.name: Douglas County events (douglasco.gov)
sources.notes: Checked 6 October 2026: WordPress with The Events Calendar; douglas.co.us redirects/canonicalises to douglasco.gov. The Tribe REST feed read successfully: 40 upcoming events, 2026-10-09 to 2027-01-18, all America/Denver, with structured venue (id, city) and categories. Sample titles: Rueter-Hess Advisory Board, Stargazing Party at Sandstone Ranch, Baby Cafe, Douglas County Fair Board meeting, Planning Commission, Business Meeting, Veterans Day (Offices Closed). Venues: Philip S. Miller Building, Castle Rock (18 of 40), BoCC Hearing Room, Castle Rock (5), Douglas County Fairgrounds, Castle Rock (1), the rest in Parker, Highlands Ranch, Englewood, Larkspur. Mostly public meetings and office closures, so the exclude list and a Castle Rock location filter are needed; the useful public categories are 'Open Space Events' (89 all-time), 'Senior Events' (64), 'Fairgrounds' (5), 'Older Adult Roadshows' (14). The categories endpoint /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/categories was also read. The iCal export https://www.douglas.co.us/events/?ical=1 answered with only 14 VEVENTs (list-view window), so JSON is the better feed. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Castle Rock Chamber of Commerce calendar
sources.notes: Checked 6 October 2026: castlerock.org (WordPress/Avada) links its 'Chamber Calendar' to a ChamberMaster/GrowthZone site at business.castlerock.org/events ('Event List | Castle Rock Chamber of Commerce'). The page carried about ten October 2026 items: Breakfast Club Leads Group, Leads Referral Group, Power Partners Leads Group, Rock Solid Leads Group, Chamber 101, Business Unwind at FirstTier Bank, Ribbon Cutting at Equity Title of Colorado, Women of Influence Luncheon. The HTML contains the comment 'link for rss not inserted' and /events/rss answered 404, so no feed; html scrape of /events or /events/calendar/<date>. Mostly member networking; the Chamber's public signature events (Artfest at Festival Park in September, Starlighting, Sip and Savor, Douglas County Fair Parade) are listed on castlerock.org menu pages. Phone (303) 688-4597. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Castle Rock Downtown Alliance / Downtown Merchants Association events
sources.notes: Checked 6 October 2026: Wix site of the Castle Rock Downtown Alliance (the DMA and the Downtown Development Authority combined), 18 South Wilcox Street #202, 303-688-7488. The 2026 Events page lists the DMA's free events: Summer Kickoff Concert (May 16), Car Show weekend (June 19-20), Boots and Brews (July 25), Oktoberfest (Sept 19), Restaurant Week (Oct 2-11), Fangtastic Festival (Oct 30), plus recurring Jazz in the Park and free summer trolley rides (Wednesdays June-August), winter trolley rides and ticketed carriage rides (Nov 22 2026 to Jan 3 2027). The /dtcrcalendar page is a Wix Events calendar (wix-events-web) with no public feed found. /dma-events-2026 is 404; the real path is /2026events. Annual, hand-maintained list, so html with a yearly refresh. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Douglas County Libraries - Castle Rock (Philip S. Miller) events
sources.defaultVenue: Douglas County Libraries - Castle Rock (Philip S. Miller)
sources.notes: Checked 6 October 2026: DCL's event calendar is Communico (go.dcl.org; dcl.org/events/ is 404). The listing script exposes RSS and iCal feeds at /feeds?data=<base64 JSON of {feedType, filters}>; the branch page dcl.org/castle-rock/ gives the Castle Rock location id 3829 (widget location=3829). The iCal feed built with location 3829 read successfully: 500 VEVENTs (appears capped), 2 RRULE, dates 2026-03-08 to 2027-11-09, every LOCATION 'Castle Rock - <room> - Castle Rock' (Kids Corner, Event Hall A). Sample titles: Coffee Chat, Baby/Toddler/Preschool Storytime, Play & Connect, Embark on Your Ancestral Journey. The 'days' filter seems ignored. Heavy on weekly storytimes, hence the exclude list for a curated guide. The branch is at 100 S. Wilcox Street, Castle Rock, (303) 791-7323. Change feedType to 'rss' in the JSON for an RSS version. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Castle Rock News-Press (Colorado Community Media)
sources.notes: Checked 6 October 2026: BLOX CMS weekly, found from coloradocommunitymedia.com (sister title douglascountynewspress.com). The article RSS read successfully: 50 items, newest 4 Oct 2026, titles such as 'Get to know the candidates running for Castle Rock Town Council', 'Castle Rock Water seeks customer input on resource plan', 'Meet the three candidates running for Castle Rock mayor'. News, not events; /local-events/ is an Evvnt-powered aggregator calendar ('Place Your Event With Evvnt') and should not be used as an event source.
